entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.348 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Jamo, District Amethi.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the sister of the informant was married to the applicant and sufficient dowry was also given.
Subsequently, on 20.12.2023, she was hanged to death by the entire matrimonial family.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant argues that the co-accused i.e. mother-in-law has been granted bail vide order dated 05.04.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.3786.
Kishan @ Krishna vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko

entities.text: Kishan @ Krishna vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
6. Considering and adopting the reasoning as contained in the order dated 05.04.2024, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Kishan @ Krishna be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 10.5.2024 nishant  Kishan @ Krishna vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161185264/
